verses: Alif Laam Meem Saad
Yeh aik kitab hai jo aap kay pass uss liye bheji gaee hai kay aap uss kay zariye say darayen, so aap kay dil mein uss say bilkul tangi na ho aur naseehat hai eman walon kay liye
Tum log uss ka ittabaa kero jo tumharay rab ki taraf say aaee hai aur Allah Taalaa ko chor ker mann gharat paraston ki ittabaa mat kero tum log boht hi kum naseehat pakartay ho
Aur boht bastiyon ko hum ney tabah kerdiya aur unn per humara azab raat kay waqt phoncha ya aisi halat mein kay woh dophare kay waqt aaram mein thay
So jiss waqt unn per humara azab aaya uss waqt unn kay mun say ba-juz uss kay aur koi baat na nikli kay waqaee hum zalim thay
Phir hum unn logon say zaroor poochen gay jin kay pass payghumbar bhejay gaye thay aur hum payghumbaron say zaroor poochen gay
Phir hum chunkay poori khabar rakhtay hain unn kay roo-baroo biyan ker den gay. Aur hum kuch bey khabar na thay
Aur uss roz wazan bhi bar-haq hai phir jiss shakhs ka pila bhari hoga so aisay log kaamyaab hun gay
Aur jiss shakhs ka pila halka hoga so yeh woh log hun gay jinhon ney apna nuksan kerliya ba-sabab uss kay kay humari aayaton kay sath zulm kertay thay
Aur bey shak hum ney tum ko zamin per rehney ki jagah di aur hum ney tumharay liye uss mein saman rizq peda kiya, tum log boht hi kum shukar kertay ho

Aur hum ney tum ko peda kiya, phir hum hi ney tumhari soorat banaee phir hum ney farishton say kaha kay Adam ko sajdah kero so sab ney sajdah kiya ba-juz Iblees kay, woh sajdah kerney walon mein shamil na hua

Haq Taalaa ney farmaya to jo sajdah nahi kerta to tujh ko uss say kaun amar mane hai, jabkay mein tujh ko hukum dey chuka, kehney laga mein uss say behtar hun, aap ney mujh ko aag say peda kiya hai aur uss ko aap ney khak say peda kiya hai
Haq Taalaa ney farmaya aasman say utar tujh ko koi haq hasil nahi kay to aasman mein reh ker takabbur keray so nikal bey shak to zaleelon mein say hai
Uss ney kaha kay mujh ko mohlat dijiye qayamat kay din tak
Allah Taalaa ney farmaya tujh ko mohlat di gaee
Uss ney kaha ba-sabab uss kay kay aap ney mujh ko gumrah kiya hai mein qasam khata hun kay mein unn kay liye aap ki seedhi raah per bethon ga
Phir unn per hamla keroon ga unn kay aagay say bhi aur unn kay peechay say bhi aur unn ki dhaani janib say bhi aur unn ki bayen janib say bhi aur aap unn mein say aksar ko shukar guzaar na payiye ga
Allah Taalaa ney farmaya kay yahan say zaleel o khuwar hoker nikal jaa jo shakhs unn mein say tera kehna manay ga mein zaroor tum sab say jahannum ko bhar ga
Aur hum ney hukum diya kay aey Adam! tum aur tumhari biwi jannat mein raho. Phir jiss jagah say chahao dono khao, aur uss darakht kay pass mat jao werna tum dono zalimon mein say hojao gay

Phir shetan ney unn dono kay dilon mein waswasa dala takay unn ki sharamgahen jo aik doosray say posheedah thin dono kay roo-baroo bey pardah kerdey aur kehney laga kay tumharay rab ney tum dono ko uss darakht say aur kissi sabab say mana nahi farmaya, magar mehaz uss wajah say kay tum dono kahen farishtay hojao ya kahen hamesha zindah rehney walon mein say hojao
Aur unn dono kay roo-baroo qasam kha li kay yaqeen janiye mein tum dono ka khair khuwah hun

So unn dono ko fareb say neechay ley aaya pus unn dono ney jab darakht ko chakha dono ki sharamgahen aik doosray kay roo-baroo bey pardah hogaeen aur dono apney upper jannat kay pattay jor jor ker rakhney lagay aur unn kay rab ney unn ko pukara kiya mein tum dono ko uss darakht say mana na ker chuka tha aur yeh na keh chuka kay shetan tumhara sareeh dushman hai?
Dono ney kaha aey humaray rab! hum ney apna bara nuksan kiya aur agar to humari maghfirat na keray ga aur hum per reham na keray ga to waqaee hum nuksan paney walon mein say hojayen gay
Haq Taalaa ney farmaya kay neechay aisi halat mein jao kay tum bahum aik doosray kay dushman hogay aur tumharay wastay zamin mein rehney ki jagah hai aur nafa hasil kerna hai aik waqt tak
Farmaya tum ko o haan hi zindagi basar kerna hai aur o haan hi marna hai aur ussi mein say phir nikalay jao gay

Aey Adam (alaihi as-salam) ki aulad hum ney tumharay liye libas peda kiya jo tumhari sharm gahaon ko bhi chupata hai aur mojib-e-ghaiz zeenat bhi hai aur taqway ka libas, yeh uss say barh ker hai. Yeh Allah Taalaa ki nishaniyon mein say hai takay yeh log yaad rakhen

Aey aulad Adam! shetan tum ko kissi kharabi mein na daal dey jaisa uss ney tumharay maa baap ko jannat say bahir kera diya aisi halat mein unn ka libas bhi utarwa diya takay woh unn ko unn ki sharm gaahen dikhaye. Woh aur uss ka lashkar tum ko aisay tor per dekhta hai kay tum unn ko nahi dekhtay ho. Hum ney shetanon ko unn hi logon ka dost banaya hai jo eman nahi latay

Aur woh log jab koi fahash kaam kertay hain to kehtay hain kay hum ney apney baap dada ko ussi tareeq per paya hai aur Allah ney bhi hum ko yehi bataya hai. Aap keh dijiye kay Allah Taalaa fahash baat ki taleem nahi deta, kiya Allah kay zimmay aisi baat lagatay ho jiss ki tum sanad nahi rakhtay?

Aap keh dijiye kay meray rab ney hukum diya hai insaf ka aur yeh kay tum her sajdah kay waqt apna rukh seedha rakha kero aur Allah Taalaa ki ibadat uss tor per kero kay uss ibadat ko khalis Allah hi kay wastay rakho. Tum ko Allah ney jiss tarah shuroo mein peda kiya tha ussi tarah tum doobara peda hogay
Baaz logon ko Allah ney hidayat di hai aur baaz per gumrahi sabit hogaee hai. Unn logon ney Allah Taalaa ko chor ker shetanon ko dost bana hai aur khayal rakhtay hain kay woh raast per hain
Aey aulad Adam! tum masjid ki her hazri kay waqt apna libas pehan liya kero. Aur khoob khao aur piyo aur hadd say mat niklo. Be-shak Allah hadd say nikal janey walon ko pasand nahi kerta

Aap farmaiye kay Allah Taalaa kay peda kiye huye asbaab zeenat ko, jin ko uss ney apney bandon kay wastay banaya hai aur khaney peenay ki halal cheezon ko kiss shakhs ney haram kiya hai? Aap keh dijiye kay yeh ashiya uss tor per kay qayamat kay roz khalis hun gi ahl eman kay liye, dunyawi zindagi mein mominon kay liye bhi hain. Hum ussi tarah tamam aayaat ko samajh daron kay wastay saaf saaf biyan kertay hain

Aap farmaiye kay albatta meray rab ney sirf haram kiya hai unn tamam fahash baaton ko jo aelaaniya hain aur jo posheedah hain aur her gunah ki baat ko aur na-haq kissi per zulm kerney ko aur uss baat ko kay tum Allah kay sath kissi aisi cheez ko shareek thehrao jiss ki Allah ney koi sanad nazil nahi ki aur uss baat ko kay tum log Allah kay zimmay aisi baat laga jiss ko tum jantay nahi
Aur her giroh kay liye aik miyad moyyen hai so jiss waqt unn ki miyad moyyen aajaye gi uss waqt aik sa’at na peechay hatt saken gay aur na aagay barh saken gay

Aey aulad Adam! agar tumharay pass payghumbar aayen jo tum hi mein say hun jo meray ehkaam tum say biyan keren to jo shakhs taqwa ikhtiyar keray aur durusti keray so unn logon per na kuch andesha hai aur na woh ghumgeen hun gay
Aur jo log humaray unn ehkaam ko jhutlayen aur unn say takabbur keren woh log dozakh walay hun gay woh uss mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay

So uss shakhs say ziyadah zalim kaun hoga jo Allah Taalaa per jhoot bandhay ya uss ki aayaton ko jhoota bataye, unn logon kay naseeb ka jo kuch kitab say hai woh unn ko mill jaye ga, yahan tak kay jab unn kay pass humaray bhejay huye farishtay unn ki jaan qabz kerney aayen gay to kahen gay kay woh kahan gaye jin ki tum Allah ko chor ker ibadat kertay thay, woh kahen gay kay hum say sab ghaeeb hogaye aur apney kafir honey ka iqrar keren gay

Allah Taalaa farmaye ga kay jo firqay tum say pehlay guzar chukay hain jinnat mein say bhi aur aadmiyon mein say bhi, unn kay sath tum bhi dozakh mein jao. Jiss waqt bhi koi jamat dakhil hogi apni doosri jamat ko laanat keray gi yahan tak kay jab uss mein sab jama hojayen gay to pichlay log pehlay logon ki nisbat kahen gay kay humaray perwerdigar hum ko unn logon ney gumrah kiya tha so unn ko dozakh ka azab do gunah dey. Allah Taalaa farmaye ga kay sab hi ka dugna hai, lekin tum ko khabar nahi
Aur pehlay log pichlay logon say kahen gay kay phir tum ko hum per koi foqiyat nahi so tum bhi apni kamaee kay badlay mein azab ka maza chakho

Jin logon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya aur unn say takabbur kiya unn kay liye aasman kay darwazay na kholay jayen gay aur woh log kabhi jannat mein na jayen gay jab tak kay oont sui kay nakay kay andar say na chala jaye aur hum mujrim logon ko aisi hi saza detay hain
Unn kay liye aatish dozakh ka bichona hoga aur unn kay upper (ussi ka) ordhna hoga aur hum aisay zalimon ko aisi hi saza detay hain
Aur jo log eman laye aur unhon ney nek kaam kiye hum kissi shakhs ko uss ki qudrat say ziyadah kissi ka mukallaf nahi banatay o hi log jannat walay hain aur woh uss mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay

Aur jo kuch unn kay dilon mein (keena) tha hum uss ko door ker den gay. Unn kay neechay nehren jari hun gi. Aur woh log kahen gay kay Allah ka (lakh lakh) shukar hai jiss ney hum ko uss muqam tak phonchaya aur humari kabhi rasaee na hoti agar Allah Taalaa hum ko na phonchata. Waqaee humaray rab kay payghumbar sachi baaten ley ker aaye thay. Aur unn say pukar ker kaha jaye ga kay uss jannat kay tum waris banaye gaye ho apney aemaal kay badlay

Aur ahl jannat ahl dozakh ko pukaren gay kay hum say jo humaray rab ney wada farmaya tha hum ney to uss ko waqiah kay mutabiq paya, so tum say jo tumharay rab ney wada kiya tha tum ney bhi uss ko waqiah kay mutabiq paya woh kahen gay haan, phir aik pukarney wala dono kay darmiyan mein pukaray ga kay Allah ki maar ho unn zalimon per
Jo Allah ki raah say aeyraaz kertay thay aur uss mein kuji talash kertay thay aur woh log aakhirat kay bhi munkir thay

Aur unn dono kay darmiyan aik aarr hogi aur aeyraaf kay upper boht say aadmi hun gay woh log, her aik ko unn kay qayafa say pehchaney gay aur ahl jannat ko pukar ker kahen gay, as-salam alaikum! abhi yeh ahl aeyraaf jannat mein dakhil nahi huye hun gay aur uss kay umeedwaar hun gay
Aur jab unn ki nigahen ahl dozakh ki taraf phiren gi to kahen gay aey humaray rab! hum ko unn zalim logon kay sath shamil na ker
Aur ahl aeyraaf boht say aadmiyon ko jin ko kay unn kay qayafa say pehchaney gay pukaren gay kahen gay kay tumhari jamat aur tumhara apney ko bara samajhna tumharay kuch kaam na aaya

Kiya yeh o hi hain jin ki nisbat tum qasmen kha kha ker kaha kertay thay kay Allah Taalaa unn per rehmat na keray ga, unn ko yun hukum hoga kay jao jannat mein tum per na kuch khof hai aur na tum maghmoom hogay

Aur dozakh walay jannat walon ko pukaren gay, kay humaray thora pani hi daal do ya aur hi kuch dey do, jo Allah ney tum ko dey rakha hai. Jannat walay kahen gay kay Allah Taalaa ney dono cheezon ki kafiron kay liye bandish kerdi hai

Jinhon ney duniya mein apney deen ko lahoo o laab bana rakha tha aur jin ko dunyawi zindagi ney dhokay mein daal rakha tha. So hum (bhi) aaj kay roz unn ka naam bhool jayen gay jaisa kay woh uss din ko bhool gaye aur jaisa yeh humari aayaton ka inkar kertay thay

Aur hum ney unn logon kay pass aik aisi kitab phoncha hai jiss ko hum ney apney ilm kamil say boht wazeh ker kay biyan kerdiya hai, woh zariye hidayat aur rehmat unn logon kay liye hai jo eman laye hain

Unn logon ko aur kissi baat ka intizar nahi sirf uss kay akheer nateeja ka intizar hai, jiss roz uss ka akheer nateeja paish aaye ga aur uss roz jo log uss ko pehlay say bhoolay huye thay yun kahen gay kay waqaee humaray rab kay payghumbar sachi sachi baaten laye thay, so abb kiya koi humara sifarshi hai kay woh humari sifarish kerdey ya kiya hum phir wapis bhejay saktay hain takay hum log unn aemaal kay, jin ko hum kiya kertay thay bar-khilaf doosray aemaal keren. Be-shak unn logon ney apney aap ko khasarah mein daal diya aur yeh jo jo baaten tarashtay thay sab gumm hogaeen

Bey shak tumhara rab Allah hi hai jiss ney sab aasmano aur zamin ko chhe roz mein peda kiya hai, phir arsh per qaeem hua. Woh shab say din ko aisay tor per chupa deta hai kay woh shab uss din ko jaldi say aa leti hai aur sooraj aur chand aur doosray sitaron ko peda kiya aisay tor per kay sab uss kay hukum kay tabey hain. Yaad rakho Allah hi kay liye khaas hai khaliq hona aur haakim hona, bari khoobiyon say bhara hua hai Allah jo tamam aalam ka perwerdigar hai
Tum log apney perwerdigar say dua kiya kero girgira ker kay bhi aur chupkay chupkay bhi. Waqaee Allah Taalaa unn logon ko pasand kerta hai jo hadd say nikal jayen

Aur duniya mein uss kay baad kay uss ki durusti kerdi gaee hai, fasad mat phelao aur tum Allah ki ibadat kero uss say dartay huye aur umeedwaar rehtay huye. Bey shak Allah Taalaa ki rehmat nek kaam kerney walon kay nazdeek hai

Aur woh aisa hai kay apni baraan rehmat say pehlay hawaon ko bhejta hai kay woh khush ker deti hain, yahan tak kay jab woh hawayen bhari badlon ko utha leti hain, to hum uss badal ko kissi khushk zamin ki taraf haank ley jatay hain, phir uss badal say pani barsatay hain phir uss pani say her qasam kay phal nikaltay hain. Yun hi hum mardon ko nikal khara keren gay takay tum samjho

Aur jo suthri zamin hoti hai uss ki paidawaar to Allah kay hukum say khoob nikalti hai aur jo kharab hai uss ki paidawaar boht kum nikalti hai, ussi tarah hum dalaeel ko tarah tarah say biyan kertay hain, unn logon kay liye jo shukar kertay hain

Hum ney Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ko unn ki qom ki taraf bheja unhon ney farmaya aey meri qom! tum Allah ki ibadat kero uss kay siwa koi tumhara mabood honey kay qabil nahi, mujh ko tumharay liye aik baray din kay azab ka andesha hai
Unn ki qom kay baray logon ney kaha kay hum tum ko sareeh ghalati mein dekhtay hain
Unhon ney farmaya kay aey meri qom! mujh mein to zara bhi gumrahi nahi lekin mein perwerdigar aalam ka rasool hun
Tum ko apney perwerdigar kay paygham phonchata hun aur tumhari khair khuwahi kerta hun aur mein Allah ki taraf say unn umoor ki khabar rakhta hun jin ki tum ko khabar nahi

Aur kiya tum uss baat say tajjub kertay ho kay tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumharay pass aik aisay shakhs ki maarfat, jo tumhari hi jinss ka hai, koi naseehat ki baat aagaee takay woh shakhs tum ko daraye aur takay tum darr aur takay tum per reham kiya jaye

So woh log unn ki takzeeb hi kertay rahey to hum ney Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ko aur unn ko jo unn sath kashti mein thay, bacha aur jin logon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya tha unn ko hum ney gharq kerdiya. Bey shak woh log andhay horahey thay
Aur hum ney qom aad ki taraf unn kay bhai Hood (alaihi as-salam) ko bheja. Unhon ney farmaya aey meri qom! tum Allah ki ibadat kero, uss kay siwa koi tumhara mabood nahi, so kiya tum nahi dartay
Unn ki qom mein jo baray log kafir thay unhon ney kaha hum tum ko kum aqali mein dekhtay hain. Aur hum bey shak tum ko jhootay logon mein samajhtay hain
Unhon ney farmaya kay aey meri qom! mujh mein zara bhi kum aqali nahi lekin mein perwerdigar aalam ka bheja hua payghumbar hun
Tum ko apney perwerdigar kay paygham phonchata hun aur mein tumhara amanatdaar khair-khuwah hun

Aur kiya tum uss baat say tajjub kertay ho kay tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumharay pass aik aisay shakhs ki maarfat, jo tumhari hi jinss kahey koi naseehat ki baat aagaee takay woh shakhs tum ko daraye aur tum yeh halat yaad kero kay Allah ney tum ko qom Nooh kay baad janasheen banaya aur deel dol mein tum ko phelao ziyadah diya, so Allah ki nematon ko yaad kero takay tum ko falah ho

Unhon ney kaha kay kiya aap humaray pass uss wastay aaye hain kay hum sirf Allah hi ki ibadat keren aur jin ko humaray baap dada poojtay thay unn ko chor den, pus hum ko jiss azab ki dhamki detay ho uss ko humaray pass mangwa do agar tum sachay ho

Unhon ney farmaya kay bus abb tum per Allah ki taraf say azab aur ghazab aaya hi chahata hai kiya tum mujh say aisay naamon kay baab mein jhagartay ho jin ko tum ney aur tumharay baap dadon ney thehra hai? Unn kay mabood honey ki Allah ney koi daleel nahi bheji. So tum muntazir raho mein bhi tumharay sath intizar ker raha hun
Gharz hum ney unn ko aur unn kay sathiyon ko apni rehmat say bacha aur unn logon ki jarr kaat di, jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya tha aur woh eman laney walay na thay

Aur hum ney samood ki taraf unn kay bhai saleh (alaihi as-salam) ko bheja. Unhon ney farmaya aey meri qom! tum Allah ki ibadat kero uss kay siwa koi tumhara mabood nahi. Tumharay pass tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik wazeh daleel chuki hai. Yeh oontni hai Allah ki jo tumharay liye daleel hai so uss ko chor do kay Allah Taalaa ki zamin mein khati phiray aur uss ko buraee kay sath hath bhi mat lagana kay kahen tum ko dard-naak azab pakray

Aur tum yeh halat yaad kero kay Allah Taalaa ney tum ko aad kay baad janasheen banaya aur tum ko zamin per rehney ka thikana diya kay naram zamin per mehal banatay ho aur paharon ko taraash taraash ker unn mein ghar banatay ho, so Allah Taalaa ki nematon ko yaad kero aur zamin mein fasad mat phelao

Unn ki qom mein jo mutakabbir sardar thay unhon ney gharib logon say jo kay unn mein say eman ley aaye thay poocha, kiya tum ko uss baat ka yaqeen hai kay saleh (alaihi as-salam) apney rab ki taraf say bhejay huye hain? Unhon ney kaha kay be-shak hum to uss per poora yaqeen rakhtay hain jo unn ko dey ker bheja gaya hai
Woh mutakabbir log kehney lagay kay tum jiss baat per yaqeen laye huye ho, hum to uss kay munkir hain
Pus unhon ney uss oontni ko maar dala aur apney perwerdigar kay hukum say sirkashi ki aur kehney lagay kay aey saleh! jiss ki aap hum ko dhamki detay thay uss ko mangwaiye agar aap payghumbar hain
Pus unn ko zalzalay ney pakra aur woh apney gharon mein ondhay kay ondhay paray reh gaye

Uss waqt (saleh alaihi as-salam) unn say mun mor ker chalay, aur farmaney lagay kay aey meri qom! mein ney to tum ko apney perwerdigar ka hukum phoncha tha aur mein ney tumhari khair-khuwahi ki lekin tum log khuwahon ko pasand nahi kertay
Aur hum ney Loot (alaihi as-salam) ko bheja jabkay unhon ney apni qom say farmaya kay tum aisa fahash kaam kertay ho jiss ko tum say pehlay kissi ney duniya jahaan walon mein say nahi kiya
Tum mardon kay sath shehwat rani kertay ho aurton ko chor ker, balkay)yeh tum to hadd hi say guzar gaye ho
Aur unn ki qom say koi jawab na bann para, ba-juz uss kay kay aapas mein kehney lagay kay unn logon ko apni basti say nikal do. Yeh log baray pak saaf bantay hain
So hum ney Loot (alaihi as-salam) ko aur unn kay ghar walon ko bacha liya ba-juz unn ki biwi kay kay woh unn hi logon mein rahi jo azab mein reh gaye thay
Aur hum ney unn per khaas tarah ka meenh barsaya pus dekho to sahi unn mujrimon ka anjam kaisa hua?

Aur hum ney madiyan ki taraf unn kay bhai Shoaib (alaihi as-salam) ko bheja. Unhon ney farmaya aey meri qom! tum Allah ki ibadat kero uss kay siwa koi tumhara mabood nahi, tumharay pass tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say wazeh daleel chuki hai. Pus tum naap aur tol poora poora kiya kero aur logon ko unn ki cheezen kum kerkay mat do aur aur zamin mein, uss kay baad kay uss ki durusti kerdi gaee, fasad mat phelao, yeh tumharay liye naafay hai agar tum tasdeeq kero

Aur tum sarkaon per uss gharz say mat betha kero kay Allah per eman laney walay ko dhamkiyan do aur Allah ki raah say roko aur uss mein kuji ki talash mein lagay raho. Aur uss halat ko yaad kero jab kay tum kum thay phir Allah ney tum ko ziyadah kerdiya aur dekho kay kaisa anjam hua fasad kerney walon ka

Aur agar tum mein say kuch log uss hukum per, jiss ko dey ker mujh ko bheja gaya, eman ley aaye hain aur kuch eman nahi laye hain to zara thehar jao! yahan tak kay humaray darmiyan Allah faisla kiye deta hai aur woh sab faisla kerney walon say behtar hai

Unn ki qom kay mutakabbir sardaron ney kaha kay aey Shoaib! hum aap ko aur jo aap kay humrah eman walay hain unn ko apni basti say nikal den gay illa yeh kay tum humaray mazhab mein phir aajao. Shoaib (alaihi as-salam) ney jawab diya kay kiya hum tumharay mazhab mein aajayen go hum uss ko makrooh hi samajhtay hun

Hum to Allah Taalaa per bari jhooti tohmat laganey walay ho jayen gay agar hum tumharay deen mein aajayen uss kay baad kay Allah Taalaa ney hum ko uss say nijat di aur hum say mumkin nahi kay tumharay mazhab mein phir aajayen, lekin haan yeh kay Allah hi ney jo humara malik hai muqaddar kiya ho. Humaray rab ka ilm her cheez ko moheet hai, hum Allah hi per bharosa rakhtay hain. Aey humaray perwerdigar! humaray aur humari qom kay darmiyan haq kay moafiq faisla ker dey aur to sab say acha faisla kerney wala hai
Aur unn ki qom kay kafir sardaron ney kaha kay agar tum Shoaib (alaihi as-salam) ki raah per chalo gay to be-shak bara nuksan uthao gay
Pus unn ko zalzalay ney pakra so woh apney gharon mein ondhay kay ondhay paray reh gaye

Jinhon ney Shoaib (alaihi as-salam) ki takzeeb ki thi unn ki yeh halat hogaee jaisay unn gharon mein kabhi basay hi na thay. Jinhon ney Shoaib (alaihi as-salam) ki takzeeb ki thi o hi khasaray mein parr gaye

Uss waqt Shoaib (alaihi as-salam) unn say mun mor ker chalay aur farmaney lagay kay aey meri qom! mein ney tum ko apney perwerdigar kay ehkaam phoncha diye thay aur mein ney tumhari khair khuwahi ki. Phir mein unn kafir logon per kiyon ranj keroon
Aur hum ney kissi basti mein koi nabi nahi bheja kay o haan kay rehney walon ko hum ney sakhti aur takleef mein na pakra ho, takay woh girr girayen

Phir hum ney uss bad-hali ki jagah khush haali badal di, yahan tak kay unn ko khoob taraqqi hui aur kehney lagay kay humaray aaba-o-ajdaad ko bhi tangi aur rahat paish aaee thi to hum ney unn ko dafatan pakar liya aur unn ko khabar bhi na thi

Aur agar unn bastiyon kay rehney walay eman ley aatay aur perhezgari ikhtiyar kertay to hum unn per aasman aur zamin ki barkaten khol detay lekin unhon ney takzeeb ki to hum ney unn kay aemaal ki wajah say unn ko pakar liya
Kiya phir bhi unn bastiyon kay rehney walay uss baat say bey fikar hogaye hain kay unn per humara azab shab kay waqt paray jiss waqt woh sotay hun
Aur kiya unn bastiyon kay rehney walay uss baat say fikar hogaye hain kay unn per humara azab din charhay paray jiss waqt kay woh apney khelon mein mashghool hun
Kiya pus woh Allah ki uss pakar say fikar hogaye. So Allah ki pakar say ba-juz unn kay jin ki shamat hi aagaee ho aur koi fikar nahi hota

Aur kiya unn logon ko jo zamin kay waris huye o haan kay logon ki halakat kay baad (unn waqiyaat waqiyaat-e-mazkoor ney) yeh baat nahi batlaee kay agar hum chahayen to unn kay jaraeem kay sabab unn ko halak ker dalen aur hum unn kay dilon per band laga den, pus woh na sunn saken

Unn bastiyon kay kuch kuch qissay hum aap say biyan ker rahey hain aur unn sab kay pass unn kay payghumbar mojzaat ley ker aaye, phir jiss cheez ko unhon ney ibtida mein jhoota keh diya yeh baat na hui kay phir uss ko maan letay, Allah Taalaa ussi tarah kafiron kay dilon per band laga deta hai
Aur aksar logon mein hum ney o wafa-e ehad na dekha aur hum ney aksar logon ko hukum hi paya

Phir unn kay baad hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko apney dalaeel dey ker Firaun aur uss kay umraa kay pass bheja, magar unn logon ney unn ka bilkul haq ada na kiya. So dekhiye unn mufisdon ka kiya anjam hua?
Aur Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney farmaya kay aey Firaun! mein rab aalameen ki taraf say payghumbar hun

Meray liye yehi shayaan hai kay ba-juz sach kay Allah ki taraf koi baat mansoob na keroon, mein tumharay pass tumharay rab ki taraf say aik bari daleel bhi laya hun, so to bani israeel ko meray sath bhej dey
Firaun ney kaha, agar aap koi moajza ley ker aaye hain to uss ko abb paish kijiye! agar aap sachay hain
Pus aap ney apna asa daal diya, so dafatan woh saaf aik azdaha bann gaya
Aur apna hath bahir nikala so woh yakayak sab dekhney walon kay roo-baroo boht hi chamakta hua ho gaya
Qom Firaun mein jo sardar log thay unhon ney kaha kay waqaee yeh shakhs bara maahir jadoogar hai
Yeh chahata hai kay tum ko tumhari zamin say bahir ker dey so tum log kiya mashwara detay ho
Unhon ney kaha kay aap unn ko aur unn kay bhai ko mohlat dijiye aur shehron mein harkaaron ko bhej dijiye
Kay woh sab maahir jadoo jadoogaron ko aap kay pass laa ker hazir ker den
Aur woh jadoogar Firaun kay pass hazir huye, kehney lagay kay agar hum ghalib aaye to hum ko koi bara sila milay ga?
Firaun ney kaha kay haan aur tum muqarrab logon mein dakhil ho jao gay
Unn saahiron ney arz kiya kay aey Musa! khuwah aap daaliye aur ya hum hi dalen?
(Musa alaihi as-salam) ney farmaya kay tum hi dalo, pus jab unhon ney dala to logon ki nazar bandi ker di aur unn per haibat ghalib ker di aur aik tarah ka bara jadoo dikhlaya
Aur hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko hukum diya kay apna asa daal dijiye! so asa ka daalna tha kay uss ney unn kay saray banay banaye khel ko nigalna shuroo kiya
Pus haq zahir hogaya aur unhon ney jo kuch banaya tha sab jata raha
Pus woh log uss moqay per haar gaye aur khoob zaleel hoker phiray
Aur woh jo saahir thay sajdah mein gir gaye
Kehney lagay kay hum eman laye rab aalameen per
Jo Musa aur Haroon ka bhi rab hai

Firaun kehney laga kay tum Musa per eman laye ho baghair uss kay kay mein tum ko ijazat doon? Be-shak yeh saazish thi jiss per tumhara amal daramad hua hai uss shehar mein takay tum sab uss shehar say yahan kay rehney walon ko bahir nikal do. So abb tum ko haqeeqat maloom hui jati hai
Mein tumharay aik taraf kay hath aur doosri taraf kay paon kaaton ga. Phir tum sab ko sooli per latka doon ga
Unhon ney jawab diya kay hum (marr ker) apney malik hi kay pass jayen gay

Aur tu ney hum mein konsa aib dekha hai ba-juz uss kay kay hum apney rab kay ehkaam per eman ley aaye, jab woh humaray pass aaye. Aey humaray rab! humaray upper sabar ka faizan farma aur humari jaan halat islam per nikal

Aur qom Firaun kay sardaron ney kaha kay kiya aap Musa (alaihi as-salam) aur unn ki qom ko yun hi rehney den gay kay woh mulk mein fasad kertay phiren, aur woh aap ko aur aap kay maboodon ko tarak kiye rahen. Firaun ney kaha kay hum abhi unn logon kay beton ko qatal kerna shuroo ker den gay aur aurton ko zindah rehney den gay aur hum ko unn per her tarah ka zor hai

Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney apni qom say farmaya Allah Taalaa ka sahara hasil kero aur sabar kero, yeh zamin Allah Taalaa ki hai, apney bandon mein say jiss ko chahaye woh malik bana dey aur akheer kaamyabi unn hi ki hoti hai jo Allah say dartay hain

Qom kay log kehney lagay kay hum to hamesha museebat hi mein rahey, aap ki tashreef aawari say qabal bhi aur aap ki tashreef aawari kay baad bhi. Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney farmaya kay boht jald Allah tumharay dushman ko halak ker dey ga aur bajaye unn kay tum ko uss zamin ka khalifa bana dey ga phir tumhara tarz-e-amal amal dekhay ga
Aur hum ney Firaun walon ko mubtila kiya qehat saali mein aur phalon ki kum peda mein, takay woh naseehat qabool keren

So jab unn per khushali aajati to kehtay kay yeh to humaray liye hona hi chahaiye aur agar unn ko koi bad-hali paish aati to Musa (alaihi as-salam) aur unn kay sathiyon ki nahoosat batlatay. Yaad rakho kay unn ki nahoosat Allah Taalaa kay pass hai, lekin unn kay aksar log nahi jantay
Aur yun kehtay kaisi hi baat humaray samney lao kay unn kay zariye say hum per jadoo chalao jab bhi hum tumhari baat her gaz na manen gay
Phir hum ney unn per toofan bheja aur tiddiyan aur ghun ka keera aur mendak aur khoon, kay yeh sab khulay khulay moajzzay thay. So woh takabbur kertay rahey aur woh log kuch thay hi jaraeem paisha

Aur jab unn per koi azab waqey hota to yun kehtay kay aey Musa! humaray liye apney rab say uss baat ki dua ker dijiye! jiss ka uss ney aap say ehad ker rakha hai, agar aap uss azab ko hum say hata den to hum zaroor zaroor aap kay kehney say eman ley aayen gay aur hum bani israeel ko bhi (raha ker kay) aap kay humrah ker den gay
Phir jab unn say uss azab ko aik khaas waqt tak kay uss tak unn ko phonchna tha hata detay, to woh foran hi ehad shikni kerney lagtay
Phir hum ney unn say badla liya yani unn ko darya mein gharq ker diya uss sabab say kay woh humari aayaton ko jhutlatay thay aur unn say bilkul hi ghaflat kertay thay

Aur hum ney unn logon ko jo kay bilkul kamzor shumar kiye jatay thay. Uss zamin kay poorab pachim ka malik bana diya, jiss mein hum ney barkat rakhi hai aur aap kay rab ka nek wada, bani israeel kay haq mein unn kay sabar ki wajah say poora hogaya aur hum ney Firaun kay aur uss ki qom kay saakhita pardakhta karkhanon ko aur jo kuch woh unchi unchi emarten banwatay thay, sab ko darhum barhum ker diya

Aur hum ney bani israeel ko darya say paar utaar diya. Pus unn logon ka aik qom per guzar hua jo apney chand buton say lagay bethay thay, kehney lagay aey Musa! humaray liye bhi aik mabood aisa hi muqarrar ker dijiye! jaisay unn kay yeh mabood hain. Aap ney farmaya kay waqaee tum logon mein bari jahalat hai
Yeh log jiss kaam mein lagay hain yeh tabah kiya jaye ga aur unn ka yeh kaam mehaz bunyad hai
Farmaya kiya Allah Taalaa kay siwa aur kissi ko tumhara mabood tajweez kerdoon? Halankay uss ney tum ko tamam jahaan walon per foqiyat di hai

Aur woh waqt yaad kero jab hum ney tum ko Firaun walon say bacha liya jo tum ko bari sakht takleefen phonchatay thay. Tumharay beton ko qatal ker daaltay thay aur tumhari aurton ko zindah chor detay thay aur uss mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say bari bhari aazmaeesh thi

Aur hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) say tees raaton ka wada kiya aur das raat mazeed say unn tees raaton ko poora kiya. So unn kay perwerdigar ka waqt pooray chalees raat ka hogaya. Aur Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney apney bhai Haroon (alaihi as-salam) say kaha kay meray baad unn ka intizam rakhna aur islaah kertay rehna aur nazam logon ki raye per amal mat kerna

Aur jab Musa (alaihi as-salam) humaray waqt per aaye aur unn kay rab ney unn say baaten kin to arz kiya kay aey meray perwerdigar! apna deedar mujh ko kera dijiye kay mein aap ko aik nazar dekh loon irshad hua kay tum mujh ko hergiz nahi dekh saktay lekin tum uss pahar ki taraf dekhtay raho woh agar apni jagah per bar-qarar raha to tum bhi mujhay dekh sako gay. Pus jab unn kay rab ney pahar per tajalli farmaee to tajalli ney uss kay purkhachay ura diye aur Musa (alaihi as-salam) hosh hoker gir paray. Phir jab hosh mein aaye to arz kiya, be-shak aap ki zaat munza hai mein aap ki janab mein tauba kerta hun aur mein sab say pehlay aap per eman laney wala hun
Irshad hua kay aey Musa! mein ney payghumbari aur apni kalaami say aur logon per tum ko imtiaz diya hai to jo kuch tum ko mein ney ata kiya hai uss ko lo aur shukar kero

Aur hum ney chand takhtiyon per her qasam ki naseehat aur her cheez ki tafseel unn ko likh ker di, tum unn ko poori taqat say pakar lo aur apni qom ko hukum kero kay unn kay achay achay ehkaam per amal keren, abb boht jald tum logon ko unn bey hukmon ka muqam dikhlata hun

Mein aisay logon ko apney ehkaam say bar-gashta hi rakhoon ga jo duniya mein takabbur kertay hain, jiss ka unn ko koi haq hasil nahi aur agar tamam nishaniyan dekh len tab bhi woh unn per eman na layen, aur agar hidayat ka raasta dekhen to uss ko apna tareeqa na banayen aur agar gumrahi ka raasta dekh len to uss ko apna tareeqa bana len. Yeh uss sabab say hai kay unhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya aur unn say ghafil rahey
Aur yeh log jinhon ney humari aayaton ko aur qayamat kay paish aaney ko jhutlaya unn kay sab kaam ghaarat gaye. Unn ko o hi saza di jaye gi jo kuch yeh kertay thay

Aur Musa (alaihi as-salam) ki qom ney unn kay baad apney zewaron ka aik bachra mabood thehra liya jo kay aik qalib tha jiss mein aik awaz thi. Kiya unhon ney yeh na dekha kay woh unn say baat nahi kerta tha aur na unn ko koi raah batlata tha uss ko unhon ney mabood qarar diya aur bari bey insafi ka kaam kiya

Aur jab naadim huye aur maloom hua kay waqaee woh log gumrahi mein parr gaye to kehney lagay kay agar humara rab hum per reham na keray aur humara gunah moaf na keray to hum bilkul gaye guzray ho jayen gay

Aur jab Musa (alaihi as-salam) apni qom ki taraf wapis aaye ghussa aur ranj mein bharay huye to farmaya kay tum ney meray baad yeh bari buri janasheeni ki? Kiya apney rab kay hukum say pehlay hi tum ney jald baazi kerli, aur jaldi say takhtiyan aik taraf rakhen aur apney bhai ka sir pakar ker unn ko apni taraf ghaseetney lagay. Haroon (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha kay aey meray maa jaye! unn logon ney mujh ko haqeeqat samjha aur qareeb tha kay mujh ko qatal ker dalen to tum mujh per dushmanon ko mat hansao aur mujh ko unn zalimon kay zail mein mat shumar kero

Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha kay aey meray rab! meri khata moaf farma aur meray bhai ki bhi aur hum dono ko apni rehmat mein dakhil farma aur to sab reham kerney walon say ziyadah reham kerney wala hai
Be-shak jin logon ney gosala parasti ki hai unn per boht jald unn kay rab ki taraf say ghazab aur zillat uss dunyawi zindagi hi mein paray gi aur hum iftra pardazon ko aisi hi saza diya kertay hain
Aur jin logon ney gunah kay kaam kiye phir woh unn kay baad tauba ker len aur eman ley aayen to tumhara rab uss tauba kay baad gunah moaf ker denay wala, rehmat kerney wala hai
Aur jab Musa (alaihi as-salam) ka ghussa farad hua to unn takhtiyon ko utha liya aur unn kay mazmeen mein unn logon kay liye jo apney rab say dartay thay hidayat aur rehmat thi

Aur Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney satter aadmi apni qom mein say humaray waqt moyyen kay liye muntakhib kiye, so jab unn ko zalzalay ney pakra to Musa (alaihi as-salam) arz kerney lagay kay aey meray perwerdigar! agar tujh ko yeh manzoor hota to uss say qabal hi unn ko aur mujh ko halak ker deta. Kiya to hum mein say chand bey waqufon ki harkat per sab ko halak kerdey ga? Yeh waqiah mehaz teri taraf say aik imtehan hai, aisay imtehanaat say jiss ko to chahaye gumrahi mein daal dey aur jiss ko chahaye hidayat per qaeem rakhay. To hi to humara kaarsaaz hai pus hum per maghfirat aur rehmat farma aur to sab moafi denay walon say ziyadah acha hai

Aur hum logon kay naam duniya mein bhi nek haali likh dey aur aakhirat mein bhi, hum teri taraf rujoo kertay hain. Allah Taalaa ney farmaya kay mein apna azab ussi per waqey kerta hun jiss per chahata hun aur meri rehmat tamam ashiya per moheet hai. To woh rehmat unn logon kay naam zaroor likhon ga jo Allah say dartay hain aur zakat detay hain aur jo humari aayaton per eman latay hain

Jo log aisay rasool nabi ummi ka ittabaa kertay hain jin ko woh log apney pass Taurat o Injeel mein likha hua patay hain. Woh unn ko nek baaton ka hukum farmatay hain aur buri baaton say mana kertay hain aur pakeezah cheezon ko halal batatay hain aur gandi cheezon ko unn per haram farmatay hain aur unn logon per jo bojh aur toq thay unn ko door kertay hain. So jo log uss nabi per eman latay hain aur unn ki himayat kertay hain aur unn ki madad kertay hain aur uss noor ka ittabaa kertay hain jo unn kay sath bheja gaya hai, aisay log poori falah paney walay hain

Aap keh dijiye kay aey logo! mein tum sab ki taraf uss Allah Taalaa ka bheja hua hun, jiss ki badshahi tamam aasmano aur zamin mein hai uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi o hi zindagi deta hai aur o hi maut deta hai so Allah Taalaa per eman lao aur uss kay nabi ummi per jo kay Allah Taalaa per aur uss kay ehkaam per eman rakhtay hain aur unn ka ittabaa kero takay tum raah per aajao
Aur qom Musa mein aik jamat aisi bhi hai jo haq kay mutabiq hidayat kerti hai aur ussi kay mutabiq insaf bhi kerti hai

Aur hum ney unn ko baara khaandanon mein taqseem kerkay sab ki alag alag jamat muqarrar ker di aur hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko hukum diya jab kay unn ki qom ney unn say pani maanga kay apney asa ko falan pathar per maaro pus foran uss say baara chashmay phoot niklay. Her her shakhs ney apney pani peenay ka moqay maloom ker liya. Aur hum ney unn per abar ko saya figan kiya aur unn ko mann o salwa (taranjabeen aur bateren) phonchayen, khao nafees cheezon say jo kay hum ney tum ko di hain aur unhon ney humara koi nuksan nahi kiya lekin apna hi nuksan kertay thay

Aur jab unn ko hukum diya gaya kay tum log uss aabadi mein ker raho aur khao uss say jiss jagah tum raghbat kero aur zaban say yeh kehtay jana kay tauba hai aur jhukay jhukay darwaza mein dakhil hona hum tumhari khatayen moaf ker den gay. Jo log nek kaam keren gay unn ko mazeed baran aur den gay

So badal dala unn zalimon ney aik aur kalma jo khilaf tha uss kalma kay jiss ki unn say farmaeesh ki gaee thi, uss per hum ney unn per aik aafat samawi bheji uss wajah say kay woh hukum ko zaya kertay thay

Aur aap unn logon say, uss basti walon ka jo kay darya-e (shor) kay qareeb abad thay uss waqt ka haal poochiye! jab kay woh haftay kay baray mein hadd say nikal rahey thay jab kay unn kay haftay kay roz to unn ki machliyan zahir ho ho ker unn kay samney aati thin, aur jab haftay ka din na hota to unn kay samney na aati thin, hum unn ki uss tarah per aazmaeesh kertay thay uss sabab say kay woh hukmi kiya kertay thay

Aur jab kay unn mein say aik jamat ney yun kaha kay tum aisay logon ko kiyon naseehat kertay ho jin ko Allah bilkul halak kerney wala hai ya unn ko sakht saza denay wala hai? Unhon ney jawab diya kay tumharay rab kay roo-baroo uzur kerney kay liye aur uss liye kay shayad yeh darr jayen

So jab woh uss ko bhool gaye jo unn ko samjhaya jata tha to hum ney unn logon ko to bacha liya jo uss buri aadat say mana kiya kertay thay aur unn logon ko jo kay ziyadti kertay thay aik sakht azab mein pakar liya uss wajah say kay woh hukmi kiya kertay thay
Yani jab woh, jiss kaam say unn ko mana kiya gaya tha uss mein hadd say nikal gaye to hum ney unn ko keh diya tum zaleel bandar bann jao

Aur woh waqt yaad kerna chahaye kay aap kay rab ney yeh baat batla di kay woh unn yahud per qayamat tak aisay shakhs ko zaroor musallat kerta rahey ga jo unn ko saza-e shadeed ki takleef phonchata rahey ga, bila-shuba aap ka rab jaldi hi saza dey deta hai aur bila-shuba woh waqaee bari maghfirat aur bari rehmat wala hai
Aur hum ney duniya mein unn ki mukhtalif jamaten ker den. Baaz unn mein nek thay aur baaz unn mein aur tarah thay aur hum unn ko khush haliyon aur haliyon say aazmatay rahey kay shayad baaz aajayen

Phir unn kay baad aisay log unn kay janasheen huye kay kitab ko unn say hasil kiya woh uss dunya-e faani ka maal mataa ley letay hain aur kehtay hain kay humari zaroor maghfirat ho jaye gi halankay agar unn kay pass wesa hi maal mataa aaney lagay to uss ko bhi ley len gay. Kiya unn say uss kitab kay uss mazmoon ka ehad nahi liya gaya kay Allah ki taraf ba-juz haq baat kay aur kissi baat ki nisbat na keren, aur unhon ney uss kitab mein jo kuch tha uss ko parh liya aur aakhirat wala ghar unn logon kay liye behtar hai jo taqwa rakhtay hain, phir kiya tum nahi samajhtay
Aur jo log kitab kay paband hain aur namaz ki pabandi kertay hain, hum aisay logon ka jo apni islaah keren sawab zaya na keren gay

Aur woh waqt bhi qabil zikar hai jab hum ney pahar ko utha ker sayebaan ki tarah unn kay upper moalliq ker diya aur unn ko yaqeen hogaya kay abb unn per gira aur kaha kay jo kitab hum ney tum ko di hai ussay mazbooti kay sath qabool kero aur yaad rakho jo ehkaam uss mein hain uss say tawaqqa hai kay tum muttaqi bann jao

Aur jab aap kay rab ney aulad Adam ki pusht say unn ki aulad ko nikala aur unn say unn hi kay mutalliq iqrar liya kay kiya mein tumhara rab nahi hun? Sab ney jawab diya kiyon nahi! hum sab gawah bantay hain. Takay tum log qayamat kay roz yun na kaho kay hum to uss say mehaz bey khabar thay
Ya yun kaho kay pehlay pehlay shirk to humaray baron ney kiya aur hum unn kay baad unn ki nasal mein huye, so kiya unn ghalat raah walon kay fail per to hum ko halakat mein daal dey ga?
Hum ussi tarah aayaat ko saaf saaf biyan kertay hain aur takay woh baaz aajayen

Aur unn logon ko uss shakhs ka haal parh ker sunaiye kay jiss ko hum ney apni aayaten den phir woh unn say bilkul hi nikal gaya, phir shetan uss kay peechay lag gaya so woh gumrah logon mein shamil hogaya

Aur agar hum chahatay to uss ko unn aayaton ki badolat buland martaba ker detay lekin woh to duniya ki taraf maeel hogaya aur apni nafsani khuwahish ki pairwee kerney laga so uss ki halat kuttay ki si hogaee kay agar to uss per hamla keray tab bhi haanpay ya uss ko chor dey tab bhi haanpay, yehi halat unn logon ki hai jinhon ney humari aayaton ko jhutlaya. So aap uss haal ko biyan ker dijiye shayad woh log kuch sochen
Unn logon ki halat bhi buri halat hai jo humari aayaat ko jhutlatay hain aur woh apna nuksan kertay hain
Jiss ko Allah hidayat kerta hai so hidayat paney wala o hi hota hai aur jiss ko woh gumrah ker dey so aisay hi log khasaray mein parney walay hain

Aur hum ney aisay boht say jin aur insan dozakh kay liye peda kiye hain, jin kay dil aisay hain jin say nahi samajhtay aur jin ki aankhen aisi hain jin say nahi dekhtay aur jin kay kaan aisay hain jin say nahi suntay. Yeh log chopayon ki tarah hain balkay)yeh yeh unn say bhi ziyadah gumrah hain. Yehi log ghafil hain

Aur achay achay naam Allah hi kay liye hain so unn naamon say Allah hi ko mossom kiya kero aur aisay logon say talluq bhi na rakho jo uss kay naamon mein kajj ravi kertay hain, unn logon ko unn kay kiye ki zaroor saza milay gi
Aur humari makhlooq mein aik jamat aisi bhi hai jo haq kay moafiq hidayat kerti hai aur uss kay moafiq insaf bhi kerti hai
Aur jo log humari aayaat ko jhutlatay hain hum unn ko ba-tadreej (girift mein) liye jarahey hain uss tor per kay unn ko khabar bhi nahi
Aur unn ko mohlat deta hun be-shak meri tadbeer bari mazboot hai
Kiya unn logon ney uss baat per ghor na kiya kay unn kay sathi ko zara bhi junoon nahi woh to sirf aik saaf saaf daraney walay hain

Aur kiya unn logon ney ghor nahi kiya aasmano aur zamin kay aalam mein aur doosri cheezon mein jo Allah ney peda ki hain aur uss baat mein kay mumkin hai kay unn ki ajal qareeb hi aa phonchi ho. Phir Quran kay baad kaun si baat per yeh log eman layen gay?
Jiss ko Allah Taalaa gumrah ker dey uss ko koi raah per nahi laa sakta. Aur Allah Taalaa unn ko unn ki gumrahi mein bhataktay huye chor deta hai

Yeh log aap say qayamat kay mutalliq sawal kertay hain kay uss ka waqoo kab hoga? Aap farma dijiye kay uss ka ilm sirf meray rab hi kay pass hai, uss kay waqt per uss ko siwa Allah kay koi aur zahir na keray ga. Woh aasmano aur zamin mein bara bhari (haadsa) hoga woh tum per mehaz achanak paray gi. Woh aap say uss tarah poochtay hain jaisay goya aap uss ki tehqiqaat ker chukay hain. Aap farma dijiye kay uss ka ilm khaas Allah hi kay pass hai lekin aksar log nahi jantay

Aap farma dijiye kay mein khud apni zaat khaas kay liye kissi nafa ka ikhtiyar nahi rakhta aur na kissi zarar ka, magar itna hi kay jitna Allah ney chaha ho aur agar mein ghaib ki baaten janta hota to mein boht say munafay hasil ker leta aur koi nuksan mujh ko na phonchta mein to mehaz daraney wala aur bisharat denay wala hun unn logon ko jo eman rakhtay hain

Woh Allah Taalaa aisa hai jiss ney tum ko aik tann wahid say peda kiya aur ussi say uss ka jora banaya takay woh uss apney joray say unss hasil keray phir jab miyan ney biwi say qurbat ki to uss ko hamal reh gaya halka sa. So woh uss ko liye huye chalti phirti rahi, phir jab woh bojhal hogaee to dono miyan biwi Allah say jo unn ka malik hai dua kerney lagay kay agar tu ney hum ko sahih saalim aulad dey di to hum khoob shukar guzari keren gay
So jab Allah ney dono ko sahih saalim aulad dey di to Allah ki di hui cheez mein woh dono Allah kay shareek qarar denay lagay, so Allah pak hai unn kay shirk say
Kiya aison ko shareek thehratay hain jo kissi cheez ko peda na ker saken aur woh khud hi peda kiye gaye hun
Aur woh unn ko kissi qasam ki madad nahi dey saktay aur woh khud bhi madad nahi saktay
Aur agar tum unn ko koi baat batlaney ko pukaro to tumharay kehney per na chalen tumharay aitbaar say dono amar barabar hain khuwah tum unn ko pukaro ya tum khamosh raho
Waqaee tum Allah ko chor ker jin ki ibadat kertay ho woh bhi tum hi jaisay banday hain so tum unn ko pukaro phir unn ko chahaiye kay tumhara kehna ker den agar tum sachay ho

Kiya unn kay paon hain jin say woh chaltay hun ya unn kay hath hain jin say woh kissi cheez ko thaam saken, ya unn ki aankhen hain jin say woh dekhtay hun, ya unn kay kaan hain jin say woh suntay hain aap keh dijiye! tum apney sab shurka ko bula lo, phir meri zarar rasani ki tadbeer kero phir mujh ko zara mohlat mat do
Yaqeenan mera madadgar Allah Taalaa hai jiss ney yeh kitab nazil farmaee aur woh nek bandon ki madad kerta hai
Aur tum jin logon ki Allah ko chor ker ibadat kertay ho woh tumhari kuch madad nahi saktay aur na woh apni madad saktay hain
Aur unn ko agar koi baat batlaney ko pukaro to uss ko na sunen aur unn ko aap dekhtay hain kay goya woh aap ko dekh rahey hain aur woh kuch bhi nahi dekhtay
Aap darguzar ko ikhtiyar keren nek kaam ki taleem den aur jahilon say aik kinara ho jayen
Aur agar aap ko koi waswasa shetan ki taraf say aaney lagay to Allah ki panah maang liya kijiye bila-shuba woh khoob sunnay wala khoob jannay wala hai
Yaqeenan jo log khuda taras hain jab unn ko koi khatra shetan ki taraf say aajata hai to woh yaad mein lag jatay hain, so yakayak unn ki aankhen khul jati hain
Aur jo shayateen kay tabey hain woh unn ko gumrahi mein kheenchay ley jatay hain pus woh baaz nahi aatay

Aur jab aap koi moajza unn kay samney zahir nahi kertay to woh log kehtay hain kay aap yeh moajza kiyon na laye? Aap farma dijiye! kay mein uss ka ittabaa kerta hun jo mujh per meray rab ki taraf say hukum bheja gaya hai yeh goya boht si daleelen hain tumharay rab ki taraf say aur hidayat aur rehmat hai unn logon kay liye jo eman rakhtay hain
Aur jab Quran parha jaya keray to uss ki taraf kaan laga diya kero aur khamosh raha kero umeed hai kay tum per rehmat ho
Aur aey shakhs! apney rab ki yaad kiya ker apney dil mein aajzi kay sath aur khof kay sath aur zor ki awaz ki nisbat kum awaz kay sath subha aur shaam aur ahl ghaflat mein say mat hona
Yaqeenan jo teray rab kay nazdeek hain woh uss ki ibadat say takabbur nahi kertay aur uss ki paki biyan kertay hain aur uss ko sajdah kertay hain
